name.full: Copilot Billing Health Check for Copilot Cowork

description.full: Checks Microsoft 365 Copilot spending policies, the groups they use and the people in those groups, then explains how to fix each problem. Reads groups, members, licenses and sign-ins through the Microsoft MCP Server for Enterprise. Read-only.
